summary: Pre-cognizance arrest powers under PMLA s.19; anticipatory bail denial; s.45(1) PMLA bail restrictions; CrPC s.88 applicability; post-cognizance custody requirements; procedural compliance post-summons appearance; remand under CrPC s.309(2); applicability of Satender Kumar Antil guidelines; mandatory PMLA conditions override CrPC provisions; special court's discretion post-prima facie finding; complaints under PMLA s.44(1)(b) analogous to chargesheets.
final_judgment: Anticipatory bail applications rejected; appeals allowed; High Court order set aside; appellants' entitlement to bail subject to PMLA s.45(1) compliance; protection from arrest maintained temporarily per interim orders.
